description:
## Functional specifications and files
Store folder configuration on canonical source identity; resolve applicable inherited/manual/pending/excluded labels deterministically with origin. Descendant reads and edits reflect folder changes and moves without duplicate evaluation or independent ancestry tree; cleanup deletions/tombstones. Persist explicit document overrides/exclusions.
Files/owners: Labels owning domain, existing Storage EntryCatalog / Channels Records ancestry contracts, relevant ingestion lifecycle/read projections.
## Tests to add before implementation
Extend shared assignment/integration tests for nested precedence, override/exclusion, origin visibility, folder edits/moves/deletion, new descendants, source isolation and permission denial. Property tests deterministic resolution/idempotency.
## Branches/paths validated
Success, invalid input, nil/denied actor, stale/concurrent write, unavailable/deleted source, lifecycle cleanup and failure rollback where relevant. No hidden cross-service calls.
## Mocking plan
Real Repo, validated Actions, NodeRouter and domain boundaries. Mock only external provider/conversion HTTP when relevant; runtime dependencies via existing Zaq.Config opts, no global mutation.
## Documentation
Update owner module docs and relevant existing service/BO guide alongside behavior; durable evidence here. Follow docs/documentation.md.
## Action reuse assessment
Extend existing EditResourceLabels and resource projections for folder scope; domain-local inheritance uses canonical source hierarchy. Folder resource is configuration scope, not definition Document/Chunk applicability. Preserve read/write actor checks and versioned atomic writes.
## Validation/dependencies
Read AGENTS.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/code-quality.md and applicable service guides. Scoped tests + mix q only per implementation issue. Final precommit reserved for final child. Supervisor verifies before closure. New feature E2E remains zaq-kw0.15 -> zaq-kw0.16.

comments.text: Root-approved implementation design (2026-11-12): keep approved source selector %{type: source, source_ref: canonical provider/config/record}; folder branch uses the existing shared Assignment store resource_type=folder, resource_id=canonical source. Folder applicability is Document, never third definition target; never ensure a folder Document. Pure effective resolver consumes already-authorized SourceRecordContext and one batched assignment read: explicit document assigned/pending/excluded wins, then nearest configured folder decision of any state, then higher folders. Persist only direct configs; preserve origin manual/automatic separately from inherited_from {source_ref,depth,assignment_version}. Editor direct expected_version remains0 for inherited-only rows; Save must compare expected_inherited_from (nil means none at open) with fresh winner after sorted definition locks, returning stale atomically on changed origin/revision/new inheritance. Existing explicit override uses ordinary CAS. Same resolver for editor/chips (including pre-ingestion document_id nil), ResourceQuery labels and key/value predicates: assigned+pending for keys, assigned only for concrete values, native false/zero retained. SQL direct-only fast path makes zero source calls when no relevant folder configs. Unfiltered metadata pages with requested labels can project after ordinary pagination; inheritance-dependent filters evaluate complete authorized non-label-filtered candidates BEFORE pagination. Only candidates lacking direct decisions need context. New-feature candidate budget5000 unresolved documents, batches max500; typed completeness/budget errors, never partial matches/counts; existing direct-only queries gain no cap. Source-owned batch prerequisite .13: depth64,1024 distinct scoped ancestor nodes, Disk ancestors_many+batch grants, remote per-request memo and one fetch per distinct target/ancestor; reuse freshly authorized listing records only server-internally. Remote distinct-target requests are real, not advertised as one provider RPC. Usage/counts describe explicit configurations, not fanout descendants; add folder configuration counts including exclusions, check Document applicability removal against document+folder rows in all states, delete shared rows transactionally. Value discovery/bulk correction edits only explicit document/chunk/folder rows, pending groups included, inherited copies excluded; source-authorize folder rows and CAS versions. Folder edits/moves affect descendants lazily from current ancestry; no hierarchy table or copied inherited assignments. Known tombstones remove exact canonical refs, with provider/config isolation; deep remote cleanup requires source-owner evidence, never inferred descendant trees. Tests cover precedence/state/value invariants, every projection/filter, stale inherited tokens including moves/new configs, usage/removal/deletion/bulk, lifecycle and query budgets. No distributed provider snapshot guarantee: current source observations are a request snapshot, local definition locks protect assignment revision comparisons. .3/.13 dependencies precede code; approved design only.

Begin independent pure effective-resolution slice while .3 source Save orchestration is implemented. Work may proceed on isolated current integrated base for existing typed Assignment +SourceRecordContext contracts; .3 dependency remains a completion/integration gate. Do not edit shared ResourceLabels/SourceLabels orchestration until .3 stable. Pure resolution and property cases first: explicit decision wins, nearest ancestor wins including exclusions/pending, origin separate inherited_from, no copied rows. Then integrate actual .3 API for folder persistence/queries/chips/usage. Existing unwatched Document retention owns its labels; do not clear Document-owned assignments just because its source tombstoned while resource is intentionally retained.

Independent kernel underway in isolated zaq-kw0.44/inheritance at integrated68f31c191; source checkpoint remains clean. Module-context/reuse evidence: Assignment owns one explicit decision and value/state/origin; SourceRecordContext owns already-authorized nearest-first topology; ResourceLabels owns editor projection/manual transaction. New local-only EffectiveLabels.resolve(document_id|nil,context,assignment_batch) composes those inputs into winning Assignment+separate inherited_from metadata; no Action, provider fetch, persistence or duplicated hierarchy. ExternalSource.source gains approved canonical-ref overload sharing its existing formatter. Tests extend existing ResourceLabels suite for all-state direct precedence, nearest pending/exclusion, untouched origin/native values, folder self scope, authoritative refs/config isolation, move/current-ancestry behavior and input-order properties. Full .4 consumer integration and .3 remain completion gates; no issue completion/commit requested yet.
